source.reported_index: 10 log10(range-length weighted mean linear Sv / 1 m^-1)
source.calibration: factory certificate with fixed retrospective regional environmental assumption; no field calibration claim
source.detection_rule: pinned per-ping 10-range-sample background subtraction and 3 dB SNR; fixed saturation, proximal range and tilt rejection
source.detection_fraction: detected native range-overlap length / geometrically available native range-overlap length over observed pings
source.acquisition_coverage: observed scheduled pings / scheduled pings, separate from detection fraction
source.known_future_acquisition_status: actual future timing, validity and counts forbidden as model inputs
source.strong_echo_selection: 3 dB censoring preferentially retains stronger returns. Conditional index cannot describe total 10-100 m acoustic state.
source.missing_state_rule: No missing, invalid or below-detection state is zero Sv or imputed truth.
source.native_target_formula: S=sum(overlap_m*detected*linear_Sv); W=sum(overlap_m*detected); target=10log10((S/W)/(1 m^-1)); zero W means missing index.

issuance.missing_past_values: mask and age; no future interpolation or truth imputation
issuance.replay_availability: zero latency at observed bin end; real telemetry availability unknown
issuance.context_profile: Trailing 96 15-minute detection-conditioned native-overlap profiles represented on fixed 2 m grid; carry exact overlap weights, masks, observed acquisition counts, detection fractions and elapsed ages available at cutoff.
issuance.scalar_aggregation: S/W directly from native range-length sums, never unweighted conditional grid-cell means.
issuance.future_truth_isolation: All issued rows receive prediction before future mask/target matching; future values, times, validity and fractions are score-only.
issuance.last_past_hour_defined_conditional_index: W>0 among detected native intervals, in addition to >=120 observed pings; no 10% detection floor on past issuance.
issuance.configuration_population: Only observed quarter-hours participate in single-configuration check; empty quarters remain missing acquisition, not a new configuration.

scoring.primary: daily equally weighted mean quantile pinball loss in detection-conditioned sampled Sv dB, equal horizons and quantiles
scoring.no_fit_overlap: context plus horizon support contained in a single partition; raw timestamps cannot cross partition

sample_adequacy.limits: Single deployment and overlapping windows do not imply independent fleets or statistical power

training.joint_supervision: Masked mean TRAIN-standardized index quantile pinball plus 1.0 times masked mean detection-fraction MSE; each on its own valid cohort, equally over available horizons; skip an absent component, fail batch when both absent.
training.conventional_fraction_head: Matched TRAIN-fitted regression or persistence head predicts detection fraction for each horizon.
training.jepa_temporal_contract: Nonzero temporal representation prediction objective in TRAIN-only pretraining; frozen-encoder supervised joint probes thereafter; EMA teacher receives no gradient, shared encoder receives target path gradient.

engineering_smoke.resume_check: interruption at64 versus uninterrupted same batch sequence

campaign.quantile_ordering: monotone parameterization or fixed rearrangement; never change truth or score cohort
campaign.candidate_grid_source: configs/experiments.json original frozen finite budget; candidate2 uses same per-family settings

uncertainty_and_value.interval_rule: frozen nonnegative widening fitted on calibration only if empirically supported
uncertainty_and_value.v2_research_hurdle: at least 5% relative primary loss improvement with paired 95% block interval favoring JEPA and no horizon worse by more than 10%; only assess if enough blocks

claim_limits: no tuna biomass, species, catch, fuel savings or production integration
no causal biological or device-intervention effect
physical_processing_scope: TRAIN development only until later independent review

selection_history.candidate1: Conservative 2 m all-overlap 38 kHz detected-cell target failed frozen 10% support: zero eligible original TRAIN fit hourly index targets; no model fitted.
selection_history.candidate2: Native range-length sampled detected-Sv target prospectively frozen after the Candidate 1 measurement-support failure, before candidate2 support or model scores.
selection_history.stop_rule: If Candidate 2 fails frozen support/adequacy, stop D1 calibrated-target and support search in this continuation; do not invent Candidate 3 from its results.
selection_history.v2_namespace: reports/v2; historical v1 registry and release never overwritten

freshness_study.input_rule: Fixed past-only observations/masks/elapsed age degraded at issuance; no replacement future values or future residuals.
freshness_study.truth_rule: Identical frozen target truth and score cohort at each age; report abstention and error by age.
freshness_study.dropout_note: The sole 38 kHz acoustic channel can become fully unavailable; report abstention, not a fabricated forecast.
freshness_study.execution_gate: After core selection and before freshness replay, freeze exact channel/block masks and seeds; do not execute the freshness study until that freeze is independently checked.
